vibe_rationale: Curated, prestigious arts festival with a strong contemporary music strand, but institutional and broad-audience rather than a scene.
fit_notes: Culturally engaged adult audience in February, with the East Perth Power Station music series the most youth-adjacent strand. A named partnerships manager gives a direct route and naming rights are on offer, but the full 2027 program launches 29 October 2026, so the partner roster should be checked then.
